signs.trace_notes: Standing bird, worn (FULL ~10122-10217, y ~1911-2024). Traced: (1) the front/neck line from the tail tip (186,522) up the diagonal body to the rounded crown (376-408, ~295): clear in relief, photo and native; (2) a faint short beak line forward from the crown along y ~290 to x ~470; (3) a faint back line parallel to the body (243,453)-(350,365), with the dark sunk body interior between the two lines near the tail; (4) the horizontal foot/base groove at y ~620 (x 212-398), faint but in all three views. Not visible: the leg (Rothoehler draws it from the belly down to the foot, at crop x ~250-300) and the back line's lower end to the tail. The groove along y ~285-290 continues right past x ~470 to ~570: that part lies over the top of R11 (61.9 f-sign, upright at FULL x ~10221) and is left to R11 (its hooked top), as 61.9's tracer suggested; where the beak ends and R11's hook begins is uncertain. Sequence: Rothoehler's first bird R9 (61.7) is lost; this is his second bird R10, left of R11 (61.9 traced crossbar at FULL y ~1967), foot above the R12/R13 row. Agrees with his drawing in shape and proportions; roth.png is well aligned here (within ~10-20 crop px).

signs.note: f-shaped sign: upright with hooked top and a crossbar, right of the bird
signs.trace_notes: Seed. Traced the sign to the RIGHT of the bird whose diagonal body runs from a tail at (520,515) to a rounded head at (705,295) (that bird = 61.8; Breasted's 61.9 box sat on its tail, ~250 crop px left of this sign). Matches Rothöhler's row 'bird + f-like sign': a near-horizontal crossbar x738-898, y474->446 (clear), a second shorter stroke diverging below it to the right, x808-885 (faint), and a stem down from the crossbar at x~811-815, y495-615 (faint, relief/photo, weak in native; low lock expected for a vertical). Breasted's 'bar with oblique end' = this crossbar. Not traced: the stem above the crossbar and Rothöhler's hooked top are not visible; a groove along y~285 from the bird's crown (720) to x~880 may be the bird's beak and/or this sign's hooked top: left to 61.8, flagged. Seq check: Rothöhler has TWO birds (row 6 lone bird, row 7 bird + this sign); the lone row-6 bird is not visible above (Breasted's 61.7 box, x712-854 y82-158, with a bar at y~175 that could be its foot), so 61.8 = row-7 bird. roth.png overlay is ~300 px too far left. fixup 2026-11-08: added R11's hooked top: the arched groove continuing the bird R10's beak line to the right, FULL ~(10218,1912)-(10236,1908)-(10249,1914), faint (relief + photo, weak in native). It sits over this sign's upright (FULL x ~10221) and turns down at the right as Rothoehler's crook does; his right-hand down-turn below ~1915 and the stem between the hook and the crossbar are not visible. The boundary with the bird's beak (61.8 traced to FULL x ~10217) is uncertain. PAST CROP EDGE: the hook lies above the kit top (FULL y 1920), traced in kit coordinates (negative y). The crop coordinates in the older note predate the kit rebuild.

signs.note: L-shaped sign (vertical with foot turned right), left; project D21 'bright mark with oblique edge' = the foot of his L
signs.trace_notes: L-shaped sign: only its foot and corner survive. One clear groove, FULL ~10130-10183, y ~2153-2167: the horizontal foot (crop x 235-362, y ~183-195) whose left end turns up into a short oblique corner (204,152)-(219,174); the wide dark shadowed upper wall over a lit lower wall is clear in relief, photo and native (= the 1901 "bright mark with oblique edge", old label D21). Rothoehler's L has a heavier triangular corner at lower left and a tall vertical rising to about the top of R13 (FULL ~2050); that vertical is not visible on the stone (above the corner only scattered wear blobs, no continuous groove in relief, native or the evidence map, also checked above the crop top): surface lost. Read left to right, this is the left sign of the row R12 (L, left) / R13 (trapezoid, middle top, 61.10) / R14 (M17, right, 61.11); it lies just below the bird R10's foot line (FULL y ~2023). KIT: green box roughly on the foot.

signs.note: small trapezoidal vessel, middle top; project '?' stacked small strokes
signs.trace_notes: Small trapezoidal vessel, read as a sunk hollow (rim traced, faint): FULL ~10161-10193, y ~2054-2101 (crop x 268-361, y 178-318). Clear deep shadowed upper wall along the top (crop y ~180-200, very dark in relief, photo and native); below it a pale hollow narrowing downwards (left side ~270->285, right side ~360->332), bottom at y ~317. Inside are two dark worn spots/strokes (crop ~(290-320, 225-242) and ~(323-360, 260-277)) which the 1901 copy read as "stacked small strokes" and the evidence map shows as three horizontal ridges; taken as damage of the floor, not traced. The side and bottom rims are placed by eye on the pale area's edges (low lock expected for a sunk rim). Matches Rothoehler's small trapezoid (middle top of the R12/R13/R14 row) in place and shape; on the stone it is somewhat taller than his. Separated from R12 (foot at FULL y ~2155-2167, to the lower left) and R14 (61.11, M17 at FULL x >= 10214) by clear gaps. KIT: green box roughly right.

Worn reed leaf, right of the vessel R13. Only a narrow pale vertical groove survives, x~213->156, y 126-540 (FULL x 10235->10216, y 2042-2180), slightly slanting down-left; consistent in photo, relief and native (per-row peak tracking). Traced as one centre line (faint); the leaf's two outlines and its pointed top are not separable. Not the column rule: the rule runs at FULL x~10255-10261 here (and 10251->10231 below the water line), ~30 px further right. Rothoehler's leaf, after correcting his overlay by the vessel R13 (his vessel ~55 kit px too far right), lies at kit x ~135-190, y ~180-505: same place and length.

Clear water line (N35), x538-828, five crests at ~x565/622/668/724/778, troughs y~497-503. Sits between the label-D21 bar (61.12, x500-660 y330-370) above and the horned viper 61.14 (x510-800 y640-700) below, exactly as Rothöhler's N35 above his viper. Green box was ~right; real sign starts ~80 px right of the box's left edge. Lower straight edge at y~520 in the photo is the lit wall, not a second line.

Horned viper facing right. Stroke 1: the body groove, clear and deep, from the tail tip at the left (kit x~140, y 261; FULL 10089,2283) level, then rising at x 255-327 to y~222, level to x~474, then the neck rising right to (532,192). Stroke 2: the head, a small sunk hollow (dark top wall, bright floor) at x~500-568, y~138-203, traced as its rim (faint; the outline is rough). The horn(s) Rothoehler draws on the head are not clear: a short pale diagonal at (562-578, 100-130) above the head may be one, not traced. Rothoehler's drawing is ~40 kit px higher and his tail ~80 px further right, same shape. Not traced: a sunk lens below the neck (x~429-510, y~261-303; FULL 10185-10212, 2283-2297) which he does not draw (damage or part of the head/neck?), and the flag tops below (y~345).

LEFT of the three god's flags (R17-R19, left to right). Only the flag top survives: a short horizontal groove x~162-252, y~135 (FULL 10114-10144, y~2313), fainter than its siblings but visible in relief, photo and native. Siblings at the same height: middle R18 = 61.17 (FULL 10154-10192, traced), right R19 = 61.18 (FULL 10196-10228). Pole and cloth are not visible (surface lost below the bar; no vertical groove edges), as for 61.17. Rothoehler's three flags are at the same heights in sequence (between the viper above and V30 below).

Middle of three R8 flags (Rothöhler's row of three flags after N35 + viper, before V30 61.19 at y~800-880). Only the flag TOP survives: a clear horizontal groove x486-588, y~446-449, sitting on the top edge of the green box. Pole and hanging cloth are not visible (surface lost; no vertical groove edges in relief or native below the bar; a dark diagonal scratch crosses its right end at x~600). Siblings, same height: 61.16 = bar x~370-440, y~452; 61.18 = bar x~620-705, y~447. Seed note: the three flag tops are ~300 px above the 1901 boxes' centres, i.e. the boxes' tops (y~450) are the signs' tops. Column-mean profiles hint at a very faint pale vertical (pole?) from the bar's left end (~x495,y470) down to ~x474,y740, and another at x~598 (61.18's pole?), but neither is visible by eye in relief/native: not traced. QA 'incomplete' is expected.

RIGHT of the three god's flags (R17-R19, left to right). Only the flag top survives: a clear horizontal groove x~153-250, y~171 (FULL 10196-10228, y~2311), its left end dipping slightly. A dark diagonal scratch crosses near its left end (x~140-160), not traced. Pole and cloth are not visible (a round pit at FULL 10198,2340 is not a groove). Siblings: left R17 = 61.16 (FULL 10114-10144), middle R18 = 61.17 (FULL 10154-10192). Rothoehler's flag is at this place in sequence.

Basket V30, cut as a sunk half-disc: straight top rim (top of the shadow band) at y~165-171, x 189-477 (FULL 10116-10212, y~2426), curved bottom rim (bottom of the lit lower wall) reaching y~258 at x 320-370 (FULL y~2456). Rim traced as a closed outline; the interior has broken, rough floor. Sunk, so the lower rim was placed by the bright->dark edge. Clear in relief, photo and native. Matches Rothoehler's V30 below the three flags.

signs.note: standing bird on a base line; project D28 'long diagonal stroke'; it is the bird's body [alias swapped: 61.20 was untraced/empty, 61.21 carries the trace]
signs.trace_notes: Clear horizontal bar x462-663, y~487-494, inside the green box (Breasted's 'bar'). Traced as the sign at this position. Rothöhler, aligned on the bird (61.20, diagonal body from (650,150) to a tail at (400,390)) and on the bars below, shows no separate sign here: the bar falls exactly on his bird's base/foot line. So 61.21 is probably part of 61.20 (bird) and the 1901 list may have one item too many in this stretch: after the bird Rothöhler has III + D28 (faint verticals x460-690 y590-690, bottom bar y~715 = 61.22 box), a long line with a central knot (bar y~825) and N35. Legs joining bird and bar are not visible. roth_agrees=false: his line is at the same place, but as the bird's base, not a sign of its own.

signs.note: three short vertical strokes, left; no project sid
signs.trace_notes: Three short vertical strokes (Z3), left of the ka arms R23, under the bird's base line (61.21, FULL y~2600). Traced left to right: x~143 (y 174-294), x~200 (y 162-276), x~258 (y 192-300); FULL x ~10100, 10119, 10138, y ~2624-2670. Separated from D28: its left upright is at FULL x~10160-10166 and its base bar starts at x~10152 (kit 300), right of stroke 3. Rothoehler's III is at the same place and size.

signs.note: ka arms, right; project '?' (Breasted's square-bracket sign)
signs.trace_notes: Ka arms (D28) as Rothoehler draws it here: a U of two uprights on a base bar. Base bar clear, x 150-321, y~230 (FULL 10152-10209, y~2669). Left upright faint, slightly slanting, x 192->170, y 90-222 (FULL ~10166->10159); right upright x~295, y 84-225 (FULL 10200, y 2620-2667), clearest at y 2640-2655; both visible as pale vertical ridges in relief and native (low lock expected for steep strokes). The outward hooks at the arms' tops and the inner lines in his drawing are not visible. His sign is ~10-15 FULL px higher in roth.png. Separated from the III (R22, strokes at FULL x 10100-10138, left of the bar's start). The bar at y~231 is Rothoehler's D28 base, not O34 (O34's knotted bar is lower, FULL y~2700).

signs.note: long bar with central knot (door bolt); project '?' bar
signs.trace_notes: Door bolt O34: long horizontal bar x 126-465, y~90-105 (FULL 10094-10207, y~2703-2708), clear at both ends (x<200 and x>360), rougher in the middle; at its centre a small sunk knot x~276-330, y~62-120 (FULL 10144-10162, y~2694-2713), traced as its rim (faint; sunk, dark top wall, bright floor). Matches Rothoehler's 'long bar with central knot' between the D28 base (FULL y~2669) and N35 (FULL y~2750). The pale area below the bar left of the knot (x~230-300, y~110-140) is wear, not traced.

signs.note: water line; project R4; the R4 is the next sign (61.26), findings seeds-r2-4
signs.trace_notes: Water line N35, worn: a low zigzag x 264-603, y~66-102 (FULL 10094-10207, y~2744-2756), visible in relief and native (clearest x 330-520); crests at FULL x ~10101/10119/10137/10155/10170/10188. Amplitude and crest positions are approximate at the right end (x>520), where the groove is shallow. The diagonal pale streaks left of it (x~220-300, y~40-140) are wiping marks, not traced. Rothoehler's N35 is at the same place (his ~15 kit px higher). This is the sign below O34 and above the S29/leaf pair (61.25): the 1901 R4 label belonged to 61.26, as noted in the inventory.

signs.note: tall narrow round-topped sign, left; project '?' two tall signs
signs.trace_notes: Breasted's 61.25 = 'two tall signs'; Rothöhler has the same pair here (tall round-topped sign left, M17 leaf right), between the long knotted line/N35 above and R4 below. Traced: the LEFT one, a narrow inverted U, arch top at (497,422), right leg clear x~507-510 down to y~590, left leg faint x~472-478, y440-515 (lower part lost). The right-hand tall sign (leaf, expected x~700-790, y~400-700) is not visible: surface lost. Low lock/support expected (steep grooves). Label/box notes: the R4 on the stone is the T-shaped sign at x430-750, y860-940 (in 61.26's box), not in 61.24's box (y388-488), which sits where Rothöhler has N35. QA off_cut reflects the steep legs (no top-light evidence), not misplacement.

signs.note: reed leaf, right; covered by 61.25's box
loaf on a mat (knob on a long bar); project '?' long bar with a small knob
signs.trace_notes: R4 as Rothoehler draws it (small knob on a long bar). Bar: clear horizontal groove x 255-570, y~273-282 (FULL 10087-10192, y~2959-2962). signs.note: reed leaf, left; project '?' two tall uprights

Its partner R30 (61.R30) is at FULL x~10175->10160, same height. Rothoehler's left leaf is at the same place and length (his ~15 kit px further left at the top). Older notes calling 61.27 'two tall uprights' covered both leaves; only the left one is traced here.

signs.note: reed leaf, right; covered by 61.27's box
signs.trace_notes: RIGHT reed leaf of the pair R29/R30 (left to right), new sign (was inside 61.27's 1901 box). Worn: a narrow pale vertical groove x 177->132, y 240-534 (FULL 10175->10160, y 3010-3108), slightly slanting down-left, with a small bright widening at y~435-450 (FULL 3075-3080); consistent in relief, native and photo. Traced as one centre line (faint). Separated from the left leaf R29 (61.27, FULL x~10101->10083) by ~70 FULL px of plain surface, and from the column rule (FULL x~10215) by ~40 px. Below y~534 a weaker pale line continues at FULL x~10154-10158 into the figure-of-eight area: not traced. The green box (FULL x 10167-10181) was ~5 px off. Rothoehler's right leaf matches in place and size.

signs.note: figure-of-eight (D-shaped loop over an oval); project '?' bar = top of the upper loop; 61.29 (traced) is the same sign [alias swapped: 61.28 was untraced/empty, 61.29 carries the trace]
signs.trace_notes: Seed, abraded. Located by sequence: Rothöhler's pair of tall leaves above (stone verticals x~427 and ~647, y~80-520 = 61.27) and below (x~427 and ~600, y~940-1160 = 61.30), with his figure-of-eight between; scaled, his '8' spans x~460-605, y~455-760 here. The broad bright triangular patch x470-550, y640-760 is a pale wear patch with no groove edges: not traced. The bar at x480-590, y~455-465 (with a small knob below) is in 61.28's box; by Rothöhler's size it would be the top of the 8's upper loop, so 61.28 may be part of this sign rather than a separate one. Loops otherwise lost.

signs.note: reed leaf, left; project '?' two tall faint uprights
signs.trace_notes: LEFT reed leaf of the pair R32/R33 (left to right), below the figure-of-eight R31. Worn: a narrow pale vertical groove x 192->147, y 201-501 (FULL 10091->10076, y 3280-3380), slightly slanting down-left; clear in relief and native (per-row tracking, strongest y 3285-3365), weaker in photo. Traced as one centre line (faint); the leaf's outlines and pointed top are not separable. NOT the column rule: the left rule runs at FULL x~10045 here (tracked smoothly from 10074 at y 2700 to 10041 at y 3400), ~40 px further left. Its partner R33 (61.R33, traced by another batch) is at FULL x~10146-10166, y 3299-3396. Rothoehler's left leaf is at the same place and size (his ~15 FULL px higher).

signs.note: reed leaf, right; covered by 61.30's box
signs.trace_notes: Right reed leaf of the pair (R32 = 61.30, traced by another agent at FULL x~10076-10091; R33 right). On the stone a narrow pale sunk streak, slightly slanting (top FULL ~10157,3300, foot ~10151,3395), ~10 FULL px wide, visible in photo, relief and native; traced as one centre line (faint), like the other worn leaves of this column (R29/R30/R32); the leaf's two outlines are not separable. Low lock is expected: near-vertical groove, light from above. The bright blob at (195,450) is a pit/spot inside the leaf. No internal notch visible (Rothoehler draws a small notch on the right side). Rothoehler's leaf in roth.png sits ~100 crop px (~33 FULL) higher and ~10 crop px left; matched by sequence (second of the two leaves above the bird R34). Separated from R32 (left leaf, ~65-75 FULL px to the left; same spacing as the pair R29/R30 above) and from the bird below (head at FULL y~3420).

Standing bird facing right, worn; drawn as in Rothoehler's leaning bird. Traced: short flat head top (y~175, x 378-445, faint, dark pit above it at (405,155) is damage), the long back line from the nape down-left to the tail tip (148,498) (clear, a deep diagonal groove with a broad pale lower wall), a short faint line parallel to it lower right ((345,402)-(285,448), underside/leg), and the base/foot bar at y~477 (x 330-455, clear; this is the old 61.32 'phantom'). Breast/front line from head to legs not visible (Rothoehler draws it). roth.png sits ~65 crop px (~22 FULL) too high (his base line at y~410, stone's at ~477); matched by sequence: leaves R32/R33 above, basket R35 (61.33) below.

V30 basket: the curved underside, a clear groove from the left tip (432,433) down to the bottom (~555-605, y~476) and up to the right tip (702,430). Matches Rothöhler's V30 (his column sits ~200 px higher in roth.png here; aligned by the bird above, whose foot bar is 61.32 at y~320, and his two long lines below = stone bars y~595 and ~720). The straight top (rim) line he draws is not visible: worn away. Broad pale band at left is the groove's lit wall, not a second outline.

Long straight horizontal groove, deep and clear (FULL x ~10057-10156, y ~3608); right third (x>230) slightly higher, a small step at x~225 (re-cut or chip). First of the two parallel lines below the basket R35 (61.33). Rothoehler's line in roth.png ~65 crop px too high; matched by sequence. The green box covered only its middle; traced the whole line.

Long straight horizontal groove, deep and clear (FULL x ~10057-10156, y ~3651); a small step at x~140 where the right part sits ~5 px higher. Second of the two parallel lines (R36 is the line at kit y~115, not traced here). BOX MISPLACED: the green box (y 147-212) lies in the empty space BETWEEN the two lines; the line is ~40 crop px below it. Rothoehler's line in roth.png ~70 crop px too high; matched by sequence.

signs.note: trapezoidal shrine-like sign on a base line
signs.trace_notes: Trapezoidal shrine-like sign on a base line: clear top bar (y~182, x 333-403), two worn sides (left slanting out to (319,315), right nearly vertical to (408,315); faint, seen as pale grooves in photo, weaker in relief/native), and a long clear base line at y~325 (x 248-460, FULL ~10061-10131, 3739). The sides end at the base line; no separate feet visible (Rothoehler draws small outward feet at the bottom corners and the top a little narrower). roth.png ~60 crop px too high and ~70 left; matched by sequence (after the two lines R36/R37, before R39/R40). The long groove at y~65 is R37 (61.35), not traced here.

signs.note: seated god with crossbar headdress, left; project traced a small Pi-shaped sign with legs here (roth_agrees false); the diagonal + bar of 61.38 would be his seat

To the RIGHT, at the same height, is a separate sign: top bar x565-665 y~497 with a pole down from its left end (x~565, y520-800) = Rothöhler's Γ; it has no sid of its own in the 1901 list unless 61.38 is it. Not traced here.

signs.note: Gamma-shaped sign (pole with top bar to the right), right; no project sid (findings seeds-r2-4)
signs.trace_notes: Gamma sign: clear deep top bar (y~234, x 178-278; FULL ~10122-10156, 3777) and a faint pole running down from its left end to ~(166,525) (FULL y~3874), seen as a pale groove in photo and weakly in relief/native. Two short isolated bright bars right of the pole, (222-276, 386) and (250-300, 505), do not touch the pole and are not in Rothoehler's drawing; not traced (maybe chips, or parts of a neighbour; flagged in findings). signs.note: small filled flat oval, left; project 'bar with small dome above'
signs.trace_notes: Small flat sunk oval (left), rim traced as a closed outline (sunk; lower edge placed by eye): x 146-253, y 221-246 (FULL ~10023-10058, 3944-3952). Clear in photo, relief and native. signs.note: small squat seated figure (bird or animal), middle; covered by 61.39's box (the 'dome above' the bar)

Rothoehler draws one squat figure here and no separate oval, so the oval is taken as its base/lower body; if the oval is in fact a separate sign (like R41 to its left), his list misses it (finding). This is the 'dome above the bar' of 61.39's 1901 box. roth.png ~65 crop px too high; matched by sequence.

signs.note: tall narrow round-topped sign, right; project '?' tall narrow sign
signs.trace_notes: Tall narrow round-topped sign (S29 per Rothoehler), worn: rounded top clear in photo/relief (y~192, FULL ~10137,3910), two legs faint (left x~201, right x~249) down to ~y 430 (FULL ~3990); traced as an open inverted U, bottom ends not seen (no closing base line). Right of the group R41/R42 at the column's right edge; the long diagonals at the lower left (y>450) belong to the bird R45 (61.41). roth.png ~60 crop px too high and slightly right; matched by sequence.

signs.note: small filled flat oval, left, above the bird; no project sid; at the top edge of 61.41's box
signs.trace_notes: Small sunk flat oval (left, above the bird R45), domed top and nearly flat bottom, rim traced as a closed outline (sunk; lower edge by eye): x 156-283, y 232-261 (FULL ~10029-10071, 3987-3997). Clear in photo, relief, native. New sign (no 1901 sid): it lies between 61.39's box (above) and 61.41's box (below); the green box (y 145-212) is ~35 crop px too high and holds no carving. The ovals at y~110 above are R41 (left) and R42's base (right). signs.trace_notes: R80 L-shaped sign: upright FULL x~10393, y5380-5409, base y~5409 from x10393 to x10500 (clear). Rothoehler's small tick on the base: only a small isolated mark at x10465-10471, y5383-5393 (relief and faint in native), ~15 FULL px above the base and not joined to it; traced as faint, uncertain.

signs.note: horizontal snake, head at right end
signs.trace_notes: R81 horizontal snake: undulating groove FULL x10380-10492, y~5444-5464, tail at left, head rising at the right end (x~10480-10492, y5444-5453). The head's details (horns/ears Rothoehler draws) are not readable. Native hints at a doubled (outlined) body at the left half; traced as a single groove.

R82 cross: horizontal FULL x10407-10468 y~5513 (left part deepest) and vertical x~10433-10434 y5481-5547. Top of the vertical (y5481-5495) lies past the crop's top edge (crop starts FULL y5495): past crop edge.

Diagonal bird facing right below the cross 64.64: back line rising from the tail at (478,550) to the neck and head at (646,385), beak/head stroke to x~690 at y~378 (faint), and the straight base line at y~615 (x512-685), which I take as the bird's feet/base line (Breasted's second number B2810; the bar 64.66 is the separate wavy line at y~720). Breast and legs are worn into a pale sunk area (x~500-650, y~480-600) with no clear groove edges: not traced. Rothoehler draws a bird on a base line at this position. Green box placement roughly right (~80 crop px low at top).

signs.note: horizontal shaft with small barbs (arrow / harpoon?)
signs.trace_notes: R84 arrow/harpoon: horizontal shaft FULL x10366-10477, y~5677-5685: a deep left segment (x10366-10405) and a thinner right part with a small dip at x~10452-10460 and rising end. The barbs he draws at the right are not separately visible (the dip may be one). PAST CROP EDGE: the sign lies entirely ABOVE this kit's crop (crop starts FULL y5704); traced in kit coordinates from wider views (work/scratch/roth-062/ov.py). Below the bird R83 (64.65).

signs.note: bread loaf, left; 64.67 = two signs side by side
signs.trace_notes: R85 X1 loaf, left: a short narrow groove FULL x10369-10400, y~5735 (thinner than his small half-loaf). PAST CROP EDGE: lies above the kit crop (crop starts FULL y5766); traced in kit coordinates. Its right neighbour is the round hollow R86 (64.R86) at x10422-10458.

R86 ring, right of the loaf R85: a SUNK round hollow FULL x10422-10458, y5725-5746, rim traced closed (sunk; no inner island visible, Rothoehler draws an open ring). Separate from R85 (ends x10400). PAST CROP EDGE: lies above the kit crop (crop starts FULL y5751); traced in kit coordinates.

signs.note: horizontal snake, head at right end; project '?' (long bar at column foot)
signs.trace_notes: R87 horizontal snake, last sign of column 64: undulating groove FULL x10362-10472, y~5772-5786, head as a deeper hollow at the right end (x~10455-10472). The straight line below it (FULL y~5805, x<10150 to 10490) runs across columns 63 and 64: it is the text's lower boundary line, not a sign; not traced.
